extracted.intended_audience: prospective Hertz Fellowship applicants (doctoral students in applied science, engineering, and mathematics), partners, and supporters
extracted.subtask_description: Information describing who the Hertz Fellowship is for, the foundation's selection priorities and values, funding terms, and the community/partnership expectations for Fellows. Useful for applicants deciding fit and preparing applications that align with Hertz priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility: doctoral students in applied science, engineering, and mathematics
rubrics_metrics.description: The Hertz Fellowship is the nation's most competitive award for doctoral students in applied science, engineering, and mathematics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should be doctoral students (or prospective doctoral candidates) in applied science, engineering, or mathematics; the program targets this specific population.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identification of 'exceptional innovators'
rubrics_metrics.description: The Hertz Foundation identifies and empowers the nation’s most exceptional innovators in science and technology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection favors candidates who demonstrate exceptional innovation and potential to produce scientific/technical breakthroughs; applicants should evidence exceptional creativity and impact potential.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scientific leadership
rubrics_metrics.description: Hertz Fellows continue to bring the scientific leadership our world needs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The foundation values and seeks applicants who show leadership potential in science and technology — e.g., leading projects, influencing fields, or advancing important lines of inquiry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core values: rigor, responsibility, and impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Hertz Fellows are 'grounded in rigor, responsibility and impact.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications and proposed work should reflect methodological rigor, ethical/responsible conduct, and an orientation toward measurable or societally meaningful impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Focus on solving pressing problems
rubrics_metrics.description: The foundation is dedicated to solving our most pressing problems — from health and energy to AI and national security.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals that address important real-world challenges or high-impact scientific/technical problems are aligned with the foundation’s mission; applicants should articulate problem relevance and potential societal benefit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interdisciplinary collaboration and community
rubrics_metrics.description: Collaboration across disciplines is at the heart of the Hertz Community; more than 1300 Hertz Fellows form an interdisciplinary, intergenerational community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work that crosses disciplinary boundaries or benefits from interdisciplinary interaction is encouraged; applicants should demonstrate ability to work across fields and engage with the Fellows community.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for bold ideas and flexibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Hertz Fellows receive up to five years of funding — offering the unique flexibility to pursue bold ideas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The fellowship’s multi-year, flexible support is intended to enable ambitious, high-risk/high-reward research; proposals should justify why extended/flexible support is needed to pursue the idea.

rubrics_metrics.name: Partnership engagement and societal application
rubrics_metrics.description: Partners — ranging from early-stage startups to world-renowned institutions — collaborate with Hertz Fellows on work that drives societal progress.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The foundation values engagement with external partners and translation of research into practice; applicants may highlight partnerships or potential collaborations that increase impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rigorous, long-established selection process
rubrics_metrics.description: Awarded through a rigorous selection process that has been honed over eight decades.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection is highly competitive and based on long-standing evaluation practices; applicants should present clear evidence of excellence, impact potential, and fit with Hertz priorities.
